observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine with visible components: intake manifold, cylinder head, wiring harness, and a transmission or gearbox attached to the bottom.
The engine appears dirty and used, with signs of wear and rust on metal parts.
Photo 1 shows the same engine from a slightly different angle, revealing more of the black plastic cover on the left side, likely part of the ECU or sensor housing.
The engine is placed on a concrete surface, possibly in a workshop or storage area.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the engine block or components in either photo.
The seller claims it is 'direct Japanese products' and 'Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.'
The watermark 'PROVISE AUTO VENTURE' is present on both photos, suggesting a reseller or dealer.

Close-up of the transmission housing and input shaft.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
